newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers slip amid holiday lethargy.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers slip amid holiday lethargy.

text.p: Bunker prices in a number of centres weakened on Friday amid slack demand, traders said.
Markets were extremely dull because of the Assumption Day holiday and a number of prices quoted by brokers were rather notional.
Rotterdam 380 cst material was heard a couple of dollars weaker at $96/$98 a tonne fob ARA, while 180 cst barrels were talked at around $5 over that.
Diesel and gas oil prices were also weakened by a fall in the value of IPE gas oil futures, which had shed some $2.50 a tonne towards the day's end. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
